description: Ministry of Industries - Notice of Cancellation of the Extra Gazette Notification No. 2351/02 Dated 25.09.2023, cancelling the Name of "Sri Lanka Swadeshiya Vaidya sabawa"
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the cancellation of a previous gazette notification that had struck off a society ("Sri Lanka Swadeshiya Vaidya Sabawa") from the register under the Societies Ordinance. The core action is a legal/regulatory matter involving the application and interpretation of ordinances (Interpretation Ordinance, Societies Ordinance) to modify the legal status of a registered entity. While a minister is named, the content does not describe his government portfolio responsibilities or announce a personnel change; his name is included only as the authority issuing the legal notice. Therefore, this falls under Legal/Regulatory (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
